description: Where each part's box sits on the map's coarse grid, [column, row]. Everything else the map draws -- box sizes, pin sides, districts, outlines, routes and bundles -- is computed from the model (apps/viewer/map.js; docs/DAG_TOPOLOGY.md, "The map"). The map is a second drawing of the same model, never a second model.

provenance.authored_by: handoff the_map_draws_the_end_stop_model, 2026-11-16; re-placed tall by handoff the_map_is_portrait_as_jeff_drew_it, 2026-11-17
provenance.arrangement: Tall, after Jeff's sketch of 2026-11-10 (Jeff, 2026-11-17: the one arrangement is portrait, so it fits the Side by side region): three columns by seven rows. The base body is the left column read upward as the hardware stacks -- hub, tangential link mount, gas-spring mount, piston cover; the pitch plate body the right column in the same sense -- pitch plate, piston body, lower head, upper head -- so the end-stop route runs across the top and the feather stop and the slide cross the middle; the tangential link between its mount and the pitch plate; the pitch link, the pitch arm and the blade down the right below the plate, the hub to blade joint along the bottom. A bearing with no place of its own sits under its link.
